proposal.name: Keep Python application tests below their timeout

plan.name: Keep Python application tests below their timeout
plan.summary: Parallelize the independent Python application proof, contract, execution, observation, held-call and module tests in the listed files, including the independent table cases in ProofRefusesTheReviewedHoles, ExecutionModuleRefusals and ContractTestsRefuseTheSecondReviewsBypasses, while preserving every assertion, refusal case, fixture cleanup and real-tool opt-in. Move the complete local GateFailures and GateFingerprints suites, with their existing test names and subtest names, to internal/verify/pythongate using GateFailures(*testing.T, bool) and GateFingerprints(*testing.T, bool) in internal/verify/internal/pythongatetest, whose false argument runs local cases and true argument also runs real cases, plus compatibility helpers for the remaining pa327 tests; their original internal/verify entry points skip unless INVARIANT_PYTHON_APPLICATION_GATE_REAL=1, when they still run both the local and real branches, so the existing real-Python CI selection keeps all its cases and the new package runs locally under go test ./... even when INVARIANT_PYTHON_PINNED=1. Tests that change process environment, working directory or package globals, directly or through helpers, remain serial, including the moved gate suites and the existing tool traps and gate-proof/exploration overrides; each concurrent case owns its mutable fixtures, temporary paths and counters and starts its deadlines only after it is scheduled. Require uncached Python 3.13 runs of internal/verify and internal/verify/pythongate to each finish within eight minutes on CI runners at Go's default parallelism with real opt-ins disabled, retain all original test coverage, and verify the changed suites with shuffled repeated runs and the race detector without weakening assertions, introducing skips beyond the two relocated entry points or raising timeouts to obtain the speedup. Update AGENTS.md and README.md to prescribe go test -timeout 10m ./... for unit tests and explain the package split, Python prerequisite and distinct existing opt-in timeouts, and update SPEC.md with the tested scheduling and coverage policy citing D-0105, D-0122 and D-0291; whoever merges records the new scheduling/timeout decision and adds its SPEC citation, since this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationIndependentCasesOverlapAndKeepResults
tests.says: Independent existing proof-refusal, module-refusal and contract-bypass cases actually overlap and keep their passing results, while tests that change PATH, another environment variable or the working directory still pass serially.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationSerialGateSuitesMoveWithoutLosingCoverage
tests.says: The two environment-changing gate suites leave the ordinary internal/verify run, execute serially with their original checks in their own package, and remain available through the existing real-Python CI entry points. The shared gate suite still rejects missing and malformed observation streams without erasing valid runtime evidence.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and two acceptance tests covering parallel execution, isolated serial gate suites, and timeout documentation. The plan check passed; `repo/` remains unchanged.
